title: Practice 5: под- and от-: up to, and away from

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Корабль медленно ___ (отойти / отходить) от пристани.
exercises.why: Студент отходит от учителя. — DLI, Lesson 29.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: The boat moved slowly away from the quay.
exercises.context: Студент отходит от учителя.

exercises.q: Чиновники ___ (подойти / подходить) к делу формально.
exercises.why: Verbs of motion with the prefix под- denote approaching to an object, a place or a person and require the preposition к + dative case: Я подхожу к столу. Рядовой подходит к сержанту. — DLI, Lesson 29.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: The officials approached the issue formally.
exercises.context: Verbs of motion with the prefix под- denote approaching to an object, a place or a person and require the preposition к + dative case: Я подхожу к столу.

exercises.q: I tried on every pair of shoes in the store, but none of them fit me.
exercises.why: The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case and is widely used with verbs of motion (the so-called "going verbs"). a) After a verb of motion, к, followed by a noun denoting a person, indicates going to see that person at his place: Я иду к полковнику. (I am going to the Colonel; to the Colonel's — his office, home, place). b) After a verb of motion, к, followed by a noun denoting an object or a place, indicates motion toward that object or place: Студент идёт к доске. Самолёты летят к морю. Мы идём к реке (к озеру). Verbs of motion with the prefix под- denote approaching to an object, a place or a person and require the preposition к + dative case:… — DLI, Lesson 29.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.context: The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case and is widely used with verbs of motion (the so-called "going verbs"). (DLI, Lesson 29)

exercises.q: Том ___ (отвезти / отвозить) Мэри домой на своём спорткаре.
exercises.why: Подвозить — подвезти — to bring up to (by vehicle), to haul up to, to give a lift; относить — отнести — to take to (on foot); отвозить — отвезти — to take (haul) to; отводить — отвести — to take (lead) to. Note that the verbs "относить", "отвозить" and "отводить" are seldom used as opposites of the verbs with the prefix "под-". — DLI, Lesson 79.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: Tom drove Mary home in his sports car.
exercises.context: Подвозить — подвезти — to bring up to (by vehicle), to haul up to, to give a lift; относить — отнести — to take to (on foot); отвозить — отвезти — to take (haul) to; отводить — отвести — to take (lead) to.

exercises.q: Наша лодка ___ (подплыть / подплывать) к маленькому острову.
exercises.why: **подплы́ть** — **подплыва́ть** — to swim or sail up to. **поднести́** — **подноси́ть** — to bring, to carry (to); to offer, to present. **подвести́** — **подводи́ть** — to lead (to) .mw-parser-output .object-usage-tag{font-style:italic}.mw-parser-output .deprecated{color:var(--wikt-palette-grey-lime-8,olivedrab)}[with к (k, + dative) ‘someone or something’]; to bring closer. **подвезти́** — **подвози́ть** — to bring; to give a lift (in a vehicle). — DLI, Lesson 29.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: Our boat approached the small island.
exercises.context: подплы́ть** — **подплыва́ть — to swim or sail up to.

exercises.q: Не ___ (подходить / подойти) близко к бульдогу, вдруг укусит.
exercises.why: **подойти́** — **подходи́ть** — to approach, to come to, to walk to, to draw near .mw-parser-output .object-usage-tag{font-style:italic}.mw-parser-output .deprecated{color:var(--wikt-palette-grey-lime-8,olivedrab)}[with к (k)]; to fit, to suit, to match, to be right [with dative]. **подъе́хать** — **подъезжа́ть** — to drive up (to); (colloquial) to drop in, to pay a short visit. **подлете́ть** — **подлета́ть** — to fly up (to), to approach; (colloquial) to run/rush up (to). — DLI, Lesson 29.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: Don't come near the bulldog in case it bites.
exercises.context: подойти́** — **подходи́ть — to approach, to come to, to walk to, to draw near .mw-parser-output .object-usage-tag{font-style:italic}.mw-parser-output .deprecated{color:var(--wikt-palette-grey-lime-8,olivedrab)}[with к (k)]; to fit, to suit, to match,…

exercises.q: Лодка ___ (отплыть / отплывать) от берега и вскоре исчезла в тумане.
exercises.why: **отплы́ть** — **отплыва́ть** — to swim away; to sail off. **отнести́** — **относи́ть** — to carry, to deliver; (of wind) to carry (off, away), to sweep (away). **отвести́** — **отводи́ть** — to lead away; to take / draw aside; to take away; to divert. **отвезти́** — **отвози́ть** — to take away (by vehicle), to drive away, to take (someone or something by vehicle). — DLI, Lesson 29.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: The boat floated away from the shore and soon disappeared into the fog.
exercises.context: отплы́ть** — **отплыва́ть — to swim away; to sail off.
